newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece plans to float more OTE by June.
newsitem.headline: Greece plans to float more OTE by June.

text.p: Greece plans to float another tranche in OTE telecom by June seeking to raise around 300 billion drachmas, sources close to the national Economy Ministry said.
Although the exact details have not been finalised yet, the government plans to sell another 10 percent of OTE and depending on the market's reception could raise it up to 17 percent.
Along with the flotation, OTE will likely proceed with a rights issue.

Now the Athens bourse's flagship, OTE offered 20 million ordinary registered shares at 4,000 drachmas a share or 7.8 times its 1995 pretax earnings, raising 96 billion drachmas in its IPO in April last year.

Its market capitalisation at issue was a hefty 1.7 trillion drachmas and the telecom promised a sweetener for those investors who hold on to their shares for 18 months -- a one for 10 bonus share distribution with a ceiling of 100 shares.

With strong revenue and cash flow growth, a largely protected market for the remainder of this decade and the potential to build a wireless business from scratch, OTE looks quite appealing, Salomon Brothers said in a February buy recommendation.

The share has done well since its trading debut on the exchange. It closed at a historical high of 6,100 drachmas in February 24 and is lately trading around 5,750 drachmas. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
